slug: 2025-01-13 FBI seeks vendors to support Somalia's biometric identification system

systems.owner: Somali Police Force; the FBI's CJIS Division is seeking vendors to operate and maintain it
systems.tiers: housed in a secure facility at Aden Adde International Airport, Mogadishu, with remote enrolment and a backup server; capacity of two million ten-print and 50,000 latent records

note: No fact: the document describes only the police fingerprint identification system (ABIS), an identification-class system, and an FBI request for information with a deadline of 24 January 2025; it states nothing about station records.
